Menu

The menu

House favorites.

The dishes guests come back for. Daily specials on the board.

Breakfast

Classic Greek omelette
Three eggs folded crepe-style around sausage, tomato, onion, spinach and feta. With toast or a biscuit and home fries, hash browns or grits.
Contains egg, milk, wheat, pork
Farmers Market omelet
Three eggs filled with fresh garden vegetables, with grits and rye toast.
Contains egg, wheat
Western omelette
Ham, bell pepper and onion, with a breakfast side and toast.
Contains egg, wheat, pork
Grilled cinnamon rolls
Baked in house, then split and finished on the grill until the edges caramelize.
Contains wheat, milk, egg
Strawberry stuffed French toast
Thick French toast with a sweet cream filling, fresh strawberries and powdered sugar.
Contains wheat, milk, egg
Pumpkin pecan pancakes
Pumpkin-spiced pancakes with toasted pecans.
Contains wheat, milk, egg, tree nuts
Home-made hash and eggs
Corned beef hash made here, two eggs your way and sourdough toast.
Contains egg, wheat
Eggs Benedict
Poached eggs and ham on an English muffin with hollandaise. Weekends only.
Contains egg, wheat, milk, pork

Lunch

Pot roast beef melt
Slow-cooked pot roast and melted cheese on grilled bread.
Contains wheat, milk
Reuben
Corned beef, Swiss, sauerkraut and dressing on grilled rye.
Contains wheat, milk, egg
Traditional or chicken gyro
Warm pita with tomato, onion and tzatziki, served with a small Greek salad.
Contains wheat, milk
Turkey bacon club
Turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, stacked on toast.
Contains wheat, egg, pork
Spinach, tomato and feta quiche
Baked in a pastry crust and served by the slice.
Contains egg, milk, wheat
Greek salad
Greens, tomato, cucumber, onion, olives and feta.
Contains milk

Made in house. Ask what is on today.
